notes.folds_paired: Paired by fold number on identical test splits. Verified: per-fold test-set sizes match the main benchmark exactly (HRD: 155/155/154/154/154; cancer typing: 1760x5), the MuAt run documented reuse of the main benchmark's split definitions, and per-sample test membership is recorded in muat_style_tcga_comparator_ab_c_full_split_manifest.csv. A per-sample cross-check against the main run's OOF predictions was not possible locally (predictions file is a Git LFS pointer).
notes.discrepancy: Fold means (0.527/0.751) from muat_style_tcga_comparator_ab_c_full_fold_metrics.csv. These are the values displayed in the manuscript. Pooled OOF values are 0.504/0.703 (muat_ablation_summary.csv, stage C). Vijay's email cited 0.519/0.729; no reply to clarification request as of 2026-10-03, so the repo-grounded fold means are used for internal consistency with the paired test.
notes.estimator: fold-mean: average of per-fold scores, matching Table 1 note
